answer: A sybil check that only works if everyone shows up at once: once per epoch, every identity gets a fresh prompt and sixty seconds to answer it, with no queue and no second sitting. One operator cannot walk 1,000 fake identities through the same window one by one, so a farm needs 1,000 people or devices present at the same minute. Miss it and the identity drops back to zero standing. The prompt itself can wander through unrelated topics, from an umber dye recipe to a lotus pond, so prewritten answers do not help.
